name: hole_60_on_the_border
why: The twin of «limit_hole_outside_the_material», and it is the most important of the four: THE CENTRE FALLS OUTSIDE THE MATERIAL (x = 157, that is exactly on the edge) and the cut is legitimate just the same. The one that runs looks at the box of the PROFILE, not at the centre.
